Amharic: ከዚያም በቡድኑ ውስጥ ያሉትን የምላሾች አዝማማያ ለመመልከት የኮምፒውተር ሞዴልን ተጠቅመዋል።

Source: They collected data from 228 people in 123 households.
Luganda: Baakuŋŋaanya obubaka okuva mu bantu 228 mu maka 123.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àkójọpọ̀ dátà láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn 228 ní àwọn agboolé tó tó 123.
Zulu: Baqoqe ingcobelelo kubantu abanga-228 emakhaya ayi-123.
Hausa: Sun tattara bayanai daga mutane guda 228 a cikin gidaje guda 123.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba kgoboketša tshedimošo go batho ba 228 ka malapeng a 123.
Amharic: ከ123 ቤቶች የ228 ሰዎች መረጃን ሰብስበዋል።

Source: They found that men who were the first in the household to be offered an HIV test declined it more often than women.
Luganda: Baazuula ng’abasajja, abaaweebwanga omukisa ogusooka ogw’okwekebeza HIV baagugaana nnyo okusinga abakyala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ri pé àwọn okùnrin tí wọń jẹ́ ẹni àkọ́kọ́ tí wọ́n fẹ́ ṣe àyẹ̀wò HIV fún nínú ìdílé nàá kọ̀ jálẹ̀ ju àwọn obìnrin lọ.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi abesilisa ababengabokuqala ekhaya ukuhlolelwa igciwane le-HIV banqaba kaningi kunabesifazane.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa mazan da suka kasance na farko a gidan da aka yi wa gwajin cutar HIV sun fi ƙin yin gwajin fiye da mata.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba hwetša gore banna bao e bego e le ba mathomo ka malapeng go kgopelwa go dirwa diteko tša HIV ba be ba gana go dirwa diteko gantši kudu go feta basadi.
Amharic: በቤተሰብ ውስጥ በመጀመሪያ የኤችአይቪ ምርመራ የቀረበላቸው ወንዶች ከሴቶች በበለጠ ብዙ ጊዜ እንዳልተቀበሉ ደርሰውበታል።

Source: About 71% of the rest of the people in the home decided not to take the test if the first person that was offered a test declined.
Luganda: Abantu abalala kyenkana abakola ebitundu 71% mu maka baasalawo obuteekebeza singa omuntu eyasooka okuweebwa omukisa gw’okwekebeza yagugaana.
Yoruba: Ìdá 71% àwọn ènìyàn tó kù ní ilé ti pinnu láti má ṣe àyẹ̀wò tí ẹni àkọ́kọ́ tọ́ fẹ́ ṣe àyẹ̀wò náà fún bá kọ̀ jálẹ̀.
Zulu: Cishe ama-71% wabanye abantu ekhaya banqume ukungahloli uma umuntu wokuqala owahlolwa enqaba.
Hausa: Kusan kashi 71% na sauran mutanen da suke gidan sun yanke shawarar ba za su yi gwajin ba idan mutumin farko da aka yi wa gwajin ya ƙi.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ye e ka bago 71% ya batho ka moka ba ka gae ba ile ba tšea sephetho sa go se dirwe diteko ge motho wa mathomo ka lapeng yo a kgopetšwego go dira diteko a ganne.
Amharic: ምርመራው የቀረበለት የመጀመሪያው ሰው ምርመራውን ሳይቀበል ከቀረ ወደ 71% የሚሆኑት ቀሪዎቹ የቤቱ ሰዎች ምርመራውን ላለመውሰድ ወስነው ነበር።

Source: With their model, they showed that when one person in a household declines HIV testing, there is a high risk that other people in the home will also decline the test.
Luganda: Nga bakozesa omutetenkanyirizo gwabwe, baalaga nti omuntu omu mu maka bw’agaana okwekebeza HIV, waliwo akatyabaga ka waggulu nnyo nti n’abantu abalala mu maka nabo bajja kugaana okwekebeza.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú àwòṣe wọn, wọ́n fi hàn pé tí ènìyàn kan ní ìdílé kan bá kọ̀ jálẹ̀ láti má ṣe àyẹ̀wò HIV, ó ṣeéṣe kí àwọn tó kù ní ilé náà kọ̀ jálẹ̀ láti má ṣàyẹ̀wò náà.
Zulu: Ngomfanekiso wabo, bakhombise ukuthi uma umuntu oyedwa ekhaya enqaba ukuhlolelwa i-HIV, kunengozi enkulu yokuthi nabanye abantu ekhaya nabo bakwenqabe ukuhlolwa.
Hausa: Tare da samfurinsu, sun nuna cewa lokacin da mutum ɗaya a cikin gida ya ƙi gwajin HIV, akwai haɗari babba cewa sauran mutanen gida su ma za su ƙi gwajin.
Northern Sotho: Ka mokgwa wa bona, ba ile ba bontšha gore ge motho wa mathomo ka lapeng a gana go dira diteko tša HIV, go na le kotsi ye kgolo ya gore batho ba bangwe ka gae le bona ba tla gana go dirwa diteko.
Amharic: በሞዴላቸው በአንድ ቤተሰብ ውስጥ አንድ ሰው የኤችአይቪ ምርመራን ሳይቀበል ከቀረ የቤቱ ሌሎች ሰዎችም ምርመራውን ላይቀበሉ የሚችሉበት ከፍተኛ ስጋት እንዳለ አሳይተዋል።

Source: They also noticed that there was no trend in the age of the people who first declined the tests.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baazuula nti tewaaliwo luwenda lwonna mu myaka gy’abantu abaasooka okugaana okwekebeza.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣàkíyèsí pé kò sí gbèdéke ọjọ́ orí àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n kọkọ kọ àyẹ̀wò náà jálẹ̀.
Zulu: Baphinde babona ukuthi wawungekho umkhuba eminyakeni yabantu abaqale benqaba ukuhlolwa.
Hausa: Sun kuma lura da cewa babu wani yanayi a cikin shekarun mutanen da suka fara ƙin gwajin.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lemoga gape gore go be go se na le setlwaedi se itšego mabapi le mengwaga ya batho bao ba thomilego ka go gana go dirwa diteko.
Amharic: ምርመራዎችን መጀመሪያ ባልተቀበሉ ሰዎች ዕድሜ ላይ ምንም ዓይነት አዝማሚያ እንደሌለ አስተውለዋል።

Source: Researchers say community health workers could use this information to help more people know their HIV status.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti abeebyobulamu mu kitundu basobola okukozesa obubaka buno okuyamba abantu abalala bangi okumanya we bayimiridde bwe kituuka ku kawuka ka HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn oṣìṣé ìléra lágbègbè léè lo àlàyé yìí láti ran ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn lọ́wọ́ láti mọ ipò HIV wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi abasebenzi bezempilo bomphakathi bangasebenzisa lolu lwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi bazi isimo sabo se-HIV.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya na al'umma suna iya amfani da wannan bayanin don taimakawa mutane da yawa su san matsayinsu na cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba re bašomi ba tša maphelo ba setšhabeng ba ka šomiša tshedimošo ye go thuša batho ba bantši go tseba maemo a bona a HIV.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የማህበረሰብ ጤና ሰራተኞች ይህንን መረጃ ብዙ ሰዎች የኤችአይቪ ሁኔታቸውን እንዲያውቁ ለመርዳት ሊጠቀሙበት እንደሚችሉ ተናግረዋል።

Source: For example, they might first offer HIV testing to people who would be more likely to say yes, or they could find ways to offer the test to people without other people in the home knowing whether they agreed to test or not.
Luganda: Okugeza, omukisa gw’okwekebeza HIV bayinza okusooka ne baguwa abantu nga balina emikisa mingi egikkiriza, oba basobola okufuna engeri z’okuwa abantu omukisa ogwekebeza awatali bantu balala mu maka kumanya oba nga bakkirizza okwekebeza oba nedda.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, wọ́n lè kọ́kọ́ fẹ́ ṣe àyẹ̀wò HIV fún àwọn tó ṣeéṣe kí wọ́n sọ pé bẹ́ẹ̀ni, tàbí kí wọ́n wá ọ̀nà láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò náà fún àwọn ènìyàn láì jẹ́ kí àwọn tó kù nílé mọ̀ bóyá wọ́n gbà láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò náà tàbí kọ̀ gbà.
Zulu: Isibonelo, bangase baqale bahlolele i-HIV kubantu okungenzeka ukuthi bathi yebo, noma bangathola izindlela zokuhlola abantu ngaphandle kwabanye abantu ekhaya bazi ukuthi bavumile yini ukuhlola noma cha.
Hausa: Alal misali, za su fara bayar da gwajin cutar HIV ga mutanen da za su iya cewa eh, ko kuma za su iya nemo hanyoyin da za su ba mutane gwajin ba tare da wasu mutanen da suke cikin gida sun san ko sun amince a yi gwajin ko a’a ba.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, ba ka thoma ka go kgopela batho go ba dira diteko tša HIV bao go nago le kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore ba ka dumela go dira diteko, goba ba ka nyaka ditsela tša go kgopela batho go ba dira diteko go se na batho ba bangwe kgauswi ka gae bao ba tsebago ge eba ba dumetše goba ba ganne.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ መጀመሪያ ለኤችአይቪ ምርመራ እሺ ሊሉ ለሚችሉ ሰዎች ሊያቀርቡ ይችላሉ፤ ወይም የቤቱ ሌሎች ሰዎች ለመመርመር መስማማታቸውን ወይም አለመስማማታቸውን ሳያሳውቁ ምርመራውን ለሰዎች የማቅረብ መንገዶችን ሊያገኙ ይችላሉ።

Source: The researchers caution that they used a small number of participants in this study, so their model may not represent the larger population.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza balabula nti baakozesa omuwendo gw’abeetabi mutono mu kunoonyereza kuno, noolwekyo omutetenkanyirizo gwabwe guyinza obutakiikirira bangi bangi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣọ́ra bí wọ́n ṣe lo àwọn akópa tí iye wọn ò pọ̀ nínu ìwádìí yìí, ó ṣeéṣe kí àwòṣe wọn má ṣàfihàn ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baxwayisa ngokuthi basebenzisa ukwahlulela kwabo lapho bebuyekeza izingxenye ezithile zemodeli.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa. sun yi amfani da mahalarta kaɗan a cikin wannan binciken, don haka, samfurinsu ba zai iya wakiltar mafi yawan jama’a ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba lemoša gore ba šomišitše palo ye nnyane ya bakgathatema ka mo dinyakišišong tše, gore mokgwa wa bona o se ke wa emela setšhaba se sentši.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ አነስተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸውን ተሳታፊዎች ስለተጠቀሙ የእነሱ ሞዴል ከፍተኛውን የህዝብ ክፍል ላይወክል እንደሚችልም ያስጠነቅቃሉ።

Source: They also couldn't test if differences in household income influenced HIV testing decisions.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era tebaasobola kugezesa kulaba oba ng’enjawulo mu nnyingiza y’omu maka yakosa okusalawo kw’okwekebeza HIV.
Yoruba: Wọn kò lè ṣe àyẹ̀wò bóyá owó tó wọlé nínú ìdílé léè ní ipa nínu ìpinnu ṣíṣàyẹ̀wò HIV.
Zulu: Abakwazanga futhi ukuhlola ukuthi ngabe umehluko emalini yekhaya ube nomthelela yini ezinqumweni zokuhlolela i-HIV.
Hausa: Har ila yau, ba za su iya gwadawa ba idan bambance-bambance a cikin kuɗin shiga na gida ya rinjayi shawarwarin gwajin cutar HIV ba.
Northern Sotho: Gape ga se ba kgona go leka ge eba diphapano ka go matseno a ka malapeng go hueditše diphetho tša mabapi le go dira diteko tša HIV.
Amharic: እንዲሁም በቤተሰብ ውስጥ ያሉት የገቢ ልዩነቶች በኤችአይቪ ምርመራ ውሳኔዎች ላይ ተጽእኖ ማሳደራቸውን መፈተሽ አልቻሉም።

Source: They suggest that future research should look at how income or the level of education affects a person’s decision about home HIV testing.
Luganda: Bateesa nti okunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu biseera ebijja kusaanye kutunuulire engeri ennyingiza oba eddaala ly’obuyigirize gye bikosaamu okusalawo kw’omuntu ku kwekebeza HIV.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dáàbá pé kí ìwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú wo bí iye owó tó wọlé tàbí bí ìpele ẹ̀kọ́ ṣe ń kópa nínu ìpinnu àwọn ènìyàn nípa ìṣàyẹ̀wò ìbùgbé ààrùn HIV.
Zulu: Baphakamisa ukuthi ucwaningo lwangomuso kufanele lubheke ukuthi imali engenayo noma izinga lemfundo lisithinta kanjani isinqumo somuntu mayelana nokuhlolelwa i-HIV ekhaya.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar cewa bincike na gaba ya kamata ya dubi yadda kuɗin shiga ko matakin ilimi yake shafar shawarar mutum game da gwajin cutar HIV a gida.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišinya gore dinyakišišo tša ka moso di swanetše go lebelela ka fao letseno goba maemo a thuto a amago sephetho sa motho ka ga diteko tša HIV ka gae.
Amharic: ወደፊት የሚደረጉ ጥናቶች አንድ ሰው የቤት ውስጥ የኤችአይቪ ምርመራን በተመለከተ በሚያደርገው ውሳኔ ላይ ገቢ ወይም የትምህርት ደረጃ እንዴት ተጽእኖ እንደሚያሳድር መመልከት እንዳለባቸው ጠቁመዋል።

Source: The authors of this paper were from Uganda.
Luganda: Abantu abaawandiika olupapula luno baali bava mu ggwanga lya Uganda.
Yoruba: Àwọn akòwé ìwé yìí wá láti Uganda.
Zulu: Ababhali baleli phepha bebevela e-Uganda.
Hausa: Mawallafan wannan takarda sun fito ne daga ƙasar Yuganda.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba pampiri ye ba be ba etšwa Uganda.
Amharic: የዚህ ጽሁፍ ጸሃፊዎች ከኡጋንዳ የመጡ ነበሩ።
